name: throttle
description: Throttle — production-grade email job scheduler with BullMQ, Redis, Postgres and Elasticsearch

scripts.build: npm run build -w @throttle/core && npm run build -w @throttle/api && npm run build -w @throttle/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @throttle/core & npm run dev -w @throttle/api & npm run dev -w @throttle/web
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis elasticsearch
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres redis elasticsearch
